changes.title: [protobuf] - encode zipcode as a string (#587)
changes.change: Address.zip_code retyped from int32 to string in pb/demo.proto
changes.why: int32 and string are not wire-compatible in protobuf; every reader of the field must regenerate

changes.title: rename proto package from hipstershop to oteldemo (#740)
changes.change: Protobuf package renamed; every generated client and type name changes
changes.why: field numbers and types are unchanged, so bytes on the topic still parse; code that names the type does not compile

changes.title: store order to postgresql from accounting service (#2175)
changes.change: accounting starts writing orders to three new Postgres tables
changes.why: nothing existing changes; lineage must discover 17 new field edges and three tables

changes.title: Add a Product Review service with GenAI-powered summaries (#2663)
changes.change: the three accounting tables move from the public schema to an accounting schema
changes.class: BREAKING for readers of the old names
changes.why: the dataset identity changes; old edges must close and new ones open, or history breaks

changes.title: [cleanup] Remove product reviews from frontend (#3568)
changes.change: the product review service and its proto messages are removed
changes.why: a node and its edges must move to retired, not vanish

changes.title: Rewrite the recommendation service in Spring Boot 4 (#3966)
changes.change: recommendation rewritten from Python to Java; it still calls product-catalog ListProducts
changes.why: the edge must survive while its static evidence moves to a new file, language and extractor; a rescan that drops it is a defect

changes.title: feat: add PII emission flag and layered redaction (#3869)
changes.trigger: flag emitRawPii switched from off to on in the twin; no code changes
changes.change: checkout and payment copy card number, CVV and email into span attributes; the collector hashes the email, keeps the last four card digits and deletes the CVV
changes.why: lineage changes on a flag change event alone; five latent edges must turn active, the collector's three masking edges start carrying data, and the two must-not-flow rules on the collector output must still hold

changes.title: Reformat fct_order_value.sql
changes.change: whitespace, keyword case and CTE alias names change; the logic does not
changes.why: normalized expressions are unchanged, so element edges and expression hashes must be identical

changes.title: Change the email service's confirmation template
changes.change: src/email (Ruby) changes how the confirmation is built; no rule set reads Ruby in wave 2
changes.why: a change in a unit the platform cannot parse is reported as unknown, never as safe

changes.title: Rename OrderResult.shipping_tracking_id to tracking_id (D15)
changes.change: field 2 of OrderResult renamed in pb/demo.proto; only checkout is updated in the same change
changes.why: the field number is unchanged, so bytes still parse, but accounting reads the field by its generated name (Consumer.cs:118) and no longer compiles

changes.title: Retype CartItem.quantity from int32 to int64 (D15)
changes.why: int32 and int64 differ on the wire for negative values and in generated code; every reader of quantity must regenerate

changes.title: Remove column state from accounting.shipping (D15)
changes.change: Consumer.cs stops writing state; the column is dropped
changes.why: stg_shipping selects *, so its output loses state; nothing reads stg_shipping#state downstream

changes.title: Add OrderResult.promo_code as field 6 (D15)
changes.change: a new optional field with a new number
changes.why: a new field number is backward compatible; no reader breaks and the gate must pass
